title: The page-writer lookup skips archived sessions
why: tag_writer ignores session_status. When triage rotates, the archived old triage session still carries its tags, so the lookup reads two writers and refuses every send-to-writer until the old row loses its tags. Triage rotation is normal work, so this is likely to bite.
note: Fix: tag_writer counts only sessions whose session_status is not archived. Red first: a list_sessions fixture with one archived and one live triage row, and today's lookup refuses. Unmeasured: no real list_sessions result with two triage rows seen yet. Builds after #3124.
